item.title: Person out thousands after online scam and other reports
item.description: Deputies received a report at 11:32 a.m. Tuesday of a person on 310th Street in Blooming Prairie who was out $14,000 after buying a vehicle online.

item.title: Riverland’s men’s basketball team earns spot in MCAC Region XIII Tournament
item.description: The Riverland Community College men’s basketball team has secured a place in the Minnesota College Athletic Conference (MCAC) Region XIII Tournament, to be played at Anoka-Ramsey Community College in Coon Rapids on Thursday.

item.title: Meet the Annunciation parents mobilizing to end gun violence in Minnesota
item.description: Dozens of school desks are lined up outside the Minnesota State Capitol this week to represent a fraction of the more than 200 Minnesota children killed by gun violence since 2021.

item.title: Albert Lea woman injured after pursuit, crash
item.description: An Albert Lea woman was critically injured Wednesday night after a pursuit ended in a crash in Cass County.

item.title: Rowland Lloyd Thomas Jr.
item.description: Rowland Lloyd Thomas Jr., known to many as Lloyd, beloved husband, father, grandfather, and friend, passed away on February 7, 2026, at the age of 88. His life was one of dedication to his family, community, and passions, and he will be deeply missed by all who had the privilege of knowing him.

item.title: 3 Tigers remain in contention for state title
item.description: Six Albert Lea wrestlers started their state tournament runs Thursday morning at Grand Casino Arena in St. Paul. Competing in the round of 16, the only individual session of the day, three won their matches and kept themselves in contention for a championship in their respective weight classes.

item.title: Traffic stop leads to seizure of about 50,000 fentanyl pills
item.description: A routine traffic stop on Interstate 90 near Albert Lea last Friday turned into the seizure of approximately 50,000 fentanyl pills, according to the Minnesota State Patrol.
